title: Novel Gene Signature Reveals Prognostic Model in Acute Myeloid Leukemia.
summary: Machine-learning feature selection identified an AML gene signature associated with survival and evaluated a prognostic model in transcriptomic cohorts; these are candidate biomarkers. External replication and prospective utility were not established in the reviewed material.
